As it progresses, there will be more infections but many fewer deaths. This is due to the virus weakening over time (as most infectious diseases do) and due to those particularly vulnerable to the disease having already died and due to the medical industry learning how best to treat the disease (i.e. don't shove a tube down peoples throats unless it is absolutely necessary). There may be spikes in deaths where pockets of previously unaffected vulnerable people encounter the disease, such as if it gets into nursing homes that were successfully isolating previously.
